detail.longDescription: So much for buying another OVH based VPS in Singapore/Asia for some of my friends to use when they are 100% out of stock and/or other good hosting providers have doubled their pricing in the last few months.... God, I love AI.... and hate it.... Yet growing my web projects and everything is too pricey right now. My small 4 vCPU, 8GB RAM, and 75GB NVME VPS at $10 is the best I am gonna do unless something changes...
